subject.title: fix: block Cloud SDK workspace env controls [AI]

question: Should all project-local CLOUDSDK_* values be treated as untrusted for OpenClaw subprocesses, rather than only the currently known Python launcher keys?
rationale: Cloud SDK uses this namespace for credentials, project selection, configuration paths, properties, and launcher behavior, but blocking it also intentionally removes project-local Cloud SDK configuration.

options.title: Block the full namespace
options.body: Accept the fail-closed workspace boundary while retaining trusted shell and global dotenv configuration.

options.title: Block enumerated controls only
options.body: Preserve selected project-local Cloud SDK settings but maintain a complete dangerous-key list with focused regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Block the full namespace
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed workspace boundary while retaining trusted shell and global dotenv configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing Cloud SDK workspace and Gmail gcloud subprocess security boundary that this PR extends.
